method: Production readback and verse-context semantic triage; classical tafsir not independently certified

records.reason: Both depict looking from the afterlife; 37:55 sees an associate in Hell whereas 83:35 describes the righteous looking from couches; not a close event parallel.
Both concern a companion leading someone toward spiritual ruin; 25:29 explicitly laments being led away from remembrance.
Both attribute deliverance from ruin to divine grace; narratives differ.
Both explicitly say the blessed do not taste death except the first death; 37:58 is a question answered by 37:59, so context is essential.
Explicit first-death exception and no further death.
Both identify the salvation/blessing as the great triumph (al-fawz al-azim).
Both urge striving/competing for the final reward, with different phrasing.
Both mention a tree associated with a test; 17:60's cursed tree is identified as zaqqum in classical exegesis, which still needs citation.
37:63 describes the tree as a trial for wrongdoers; 44:43 names zaqqum as food of the sinner. Same object, different proposition.
37:64 locates zaqqum at the bottom of Hell; 44:43 names the tree as food of the sinner, without the location.
